On the retained fixtures, the native Engine recovers declared neutral pressure–enthalpy (PH) and
pressure–entropy (PS) states with extensive targets on the resolved feed basis.
[The retained rows](results/issue-224-sliceA/native-comparisons.csv) contain the
public-Properties round trips, pure saturation lever relations, ordinary
reaction consistency, exact action identities and off-solution derivative
ladders. Their adopted quantities, inputs and criteria remain in
[issue #224](https://github.com/tannerpolley/ePC-SAFT/issues/224) and the
[caloric specification equations](../../engine/docs/equations.md#extensive_enthalpy_specification).

{{< include results/issue-224-sliceA/qualification-table.md >}}

Each maximum divides the retained comparison error by its own unchanged
criterion. Closure uses positive feed/thermal scales; it never divides by an
arbitrary caloric target near zero. The callback comparisons retain raw matrix
entries, coordinate scales and centered refinement before the rounding floor.
Mixed control actions refine lower exact actions with centered extrapolation;
conditioning and linear backward errors accompany those rows.

The [independent comparison](results/issue-224-sliceA/reference/comparisons.csv)
uses FeOs on identical residual parameters, gas constant and manufactured
DIPPR records, with explicit molar-to-kilomolar coefficient conversion.
Both implementations receive one common Engine enthalpy or entropy increment
and their own baseline anchor. Their native flashes agree on temperature,
composition and split. The [reference declarations](results/issue-224-sliceA/reference/reference-inputs.json)
and [provenance](results/issue-224-sliceA/provenance.json) retain source identity,
wheel hashes, source standards and the numerical comparison domain.

Regular PH/PS roots receive the existing fixed-temperature/pressure local
curvature diagnostic. Pure coexistence instead has a caloric lever-fixed
split and an analytically flat Gibbs split; ordinary equilibrium heat capacity
and strict split curvature remain unavailable. Missing records, excluded
intervals and discontinuous joins preserve their distinct caloric causes.
Existing residual-only quantities remain available under their own admission.

This is numerical verification and agreement between implementations, using
manufactured thermal inputs. It supplies no physical validation, global
stability conclusion or charged-caloric result; critical points and envelopes
follow in the next section.
The [paired key-solve evidence](results/issue-224-sliceA/provenance.json) records
unchanged work; shared-host wall-time spread supports no isolated speed claim.
Independent delivered review remains with the lead. This notebook has not been
promoted for manuscript use.

## Critical-equation candidates and phase envelopes

The selected F4 evidence is the discrete critical and bubble/dew comparison
in `results/issue-224-sliceB/reference/`. These retained reference points do
not supply a continuous envelope. The separately retained curves in
[the algorithm illustrations](../2026-algorithm-illustrations/notebook.qmd)
have their own calculation and review boundary. The source-matched render
of this notebook reads the corrected qualification tables and reference
locators without running a model calculation. Independent delivered review
and investigator promotion of this selected presentation remain open.

Issue #224 slice B solves the necessary Heidemann–Khalil critical conditions of
one neutral phase and traces vapor–liquid envelopes with the native local
parametrization, on the Gross (2001) propane and methane/ethane packets.
[The retained rows](results/issue-224-sliceB/native-comparisons.csv) hold the
native falsifiers: the pure and binary candidates and their spectra, the
pressure-slope identities with their propagated floor, first composition
actions against refined central solves, the fifth-order energy contraction
against the difference of exact fourth-order contractions, off-solution
Jacobian and weighted-curvature ladders of the critical and envelope rows, the
Clapeyron identity, the pure-fluid endpoint and the mixture envelope closure at
three bracketing step levels. The equations are
[`critical_equations`](../../engine/docs/equations.md#critical_equations) and
[`envelope_local_condition`](../../engine/docs/equations.md#envelope_local_condition).

{{< include results/issue-224-sliceB/qualification-table.md >}}

Each maximum divides the retained error by its own unchanged criterion. The
[independent comparisons](results/issue-224-sliceB/reference/comparisons.csv)
use FeOs and teqp on the same residual parameters and gas constant. teqp has
no fixed-composition binary critical solve, so the Engine cell is solved at
teqp's own polished locus compositions nearest the two FeOs compositions; FeOs
solves at exactly those compositions. FeOs bubble and dew points at common
temperatures start from the Engine pressure and incipient composition, which
select the branch where two retrograde dew points exist. The
[reference declarations](results/issue-224-sliceB/reference/reference-inputs.json)
and [provenance](results/issue-224-sliceB/provenance.json) retain versions,
solver options, hashes and limits.

A solved critical cell is a critical-equation candidate: one lowest zero
eigenvalue of the scaled composition Hessian, not a stability certificate. A
pure-fluid candidate's isobaric heat capacities divide by its zero pressure
slope and are unavailable; a mixture candidate keeps a positive pressure slope,
and its residual and total isobaric heat capacities match the direct
state-property route in C3. Second and third solved-state actions are refused
with central values kept. The Hermite seeds of the mixture passage are retained with their
successive differences; they do not show fourth-order convergence, so no
order is claimed for them. Each seed only starts the critical solve.

E3's Clapeyron rows use the existing fixed-temperature saturation actions, not
the envelope tangent. The envelope tangent J dy/ds = e is backed instead by the
envelope-row derivative ladder and by E1's Hermite seeds, which reach the C3
candidate within the retained seed differences. The derivative-ladder rows
retain, for each matrix entry, the exact and centered-difference values at the
best step and the coordinate scale.

This is numerical verification and agreement between implementations. It
supplies no physical validation, stability classification of the candidates,
liquid–liquid, reactive, charged or three-phase envelope. The key-solve work in
the provenance is unchanged. Independent delivered review remains with the
lead; this notebook has not been promoted for manuscript use.
